svg.title: Kuroshio Extension: OSW editorial reference-route candidate
svg.desc: Equirectangular schematic. Approximately 1400 km. NOAA glossary Kuroshio Extension extent from approximately 145 to 160 degrees E, upstream of its separately named North Pacific Current. This naming convention is not a universal termination rule for all Kuroshio Extension literature; excludes the coastal Kuroshio, recirculation gyres and downstream North Pacific extent. Source describes regional geography; OSW selects the drawn route. No measured current axis.
svg.text: OSW approximate NOAA Kuroshio Extension extent — candidate
Dashed: nominal route · pale: 27 editorial scenarios
Not an observed axis or statistical confidence interval
Source: NOAA currents glossary; OSW selects vertices
Equirectangular OSW atlas ground · scientific review pending
